title: A caller's abort leaves Drive's shared document-folder lookup running
evidence: packages/health-core/src/drive-rest.ts docTarget: untilAborted ends the caller's wait at its deadline, but documentFolder's requests run on to their own 30 s bound and, if they then succeed, may go on to further lookups or a folder create (Codex re-check R1 on PR 1636: a fresh adapter, one readDocument caller aborting at 1 s, the stalled discovery fetch stays open until 30 s). Kept by the owner 2026-11-13: no caller with a signal reaches this path today.
